title: world/formations.json, jrpgbattle world format 2026-11-26
description: The formations, by id (decision 0103): a team's line-up slots arranged in lines from front to back, and the cover each line gives. A formation is for the team size its slots cover. No grid and no coordinates: a client draws each line as a column or a row. A unit behind a line has a chance, its cover, that a single-target attack aimed at it lands on a front-liner instead; its cover shrinks as the allies in front of it fall. The ruleset's maxCover (its rules) caps every line's cover.

lines.description: Front to back. Every slot from 0 to one less than the team size is in exactly one line, and the front line's cover is 0.

default.description: The formation a team of its size stands in when it chooses none. At most one per size; with none, such a team stands in line-up order with no cover.

slots.description: The line-up slots standing in this line, top to bottom: what "directly in front" means for a redirect, and "beside" for a blast's splash.

cover.description: The line's full cover, a share (0.25 is 25%), at most the ruleset's maxCover. It shrinks in proportion to the allies in every line ahead who have fallen.
